Name: Fix Android Photo Upload Crash
Description: Resolve NullPointerException in media picker callback on Android 14 when app is backgrounded during photo upload. Steps to Reproduce: Start photo upload, background the app before it finishes, return to app. Acceptance Criteria: Fix should be verified by QA by Wednesday, confirmed on Android 14 test devices.

Name: Implement Offline Mode for Notes List
Description: Develop backend sync API and client-side offline functionality for notes. Backend: Sync API that sends the last-synced timestamp and returns a delta of changes. Client: Local cache with Room, queuing offline writes and replaying them upon reconnection. Acceptance Criteria: The app can be opened in airplane mode, notes can be viewed and edited offline, and data syncs without loss when back online.

Name: Migrate CI Pipelines to GitHub Actions
Description: Migrate current Jenkins CI pipelines to GitHub Actions, completing test and release pipelines. Maintain nightly build schedule and run both Jenkins and GitHub Actions in parallel for a week to ensure stability before shutting down Jenkins.

Name: Implement Per-User Rate Limiting on Search Endpoint
Description: Add rate limiting to search endpoint with a limit of 100 requests per minute per user. Return HTTP 429 and Retry-After header for exceeded requests. Include a metrics counter to track API usage.

Name: Update Privacy Policy Screen for GDPR Compliance
Description: Modify privacy policy consent screen to include separate opt-in toggles for analytics and marketing without pre-checked boxes. Ensure compliance by the August 20 release, as it is a launch blocker.

Name: Automate Payments Flow Testing
Description: Create regression tests for the payments flow, covering purchase, restore, cancellation, and receipt validation paths. Integrate these tests into the CI pipeline on GitHub Actions.
